obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to manage_payees, a privileged action in the approved payments access policy, but is declared mfa=False. The registered exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on the head commit, naming exactly this route.
The change relies on EXC-0214 (MFA-1, payments.routes). It was approved by risk owner Helena Vasquez but expired on 2026-10-19, before the review time of 2026-10-22, so it cannot cover the deviation.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1) covers routes.py, which this change alters in behaviour, so that evidence has lapsed. The replacement evidence of the same strength (the exhaustive route control test) fails.

The CI run on head e91e4ff reports result 'failure', with 1 of 172 tests failing: the registered MFA-1 control test. The JUnit report is also timestamped 2026-10-23 from host dev-laptop-7.local, which is after the review time and not the CI executor, so its provenance is doubtful.
Ticket CHG-25655 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-14, before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
Mara Costa holds the change_approver role for payments and is not the author (Sofia Santos). She approved a code_review on the head commit.
Both approvals name the head commit e91e4ff, which is the only commit on the change.
The change touches security-sensitive components (payments.routes, payments.http, payments.store). Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer, approved a security_review on the head commit.
The new state-changing reopen_payee calls _audit, which records the actor, action 'reopen_payee', target payee:{id} and the clock time. The sampled audit control test passes.
The new store method only updates status and closed_at and writes no NPI columns. The exhaustive encryption control test passes.
The new UPDATE statement is a fixed string literal with payee_id bound as a ? parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passes.
The added code introduces no log calls, and existing log call sites in the touched files are unchanged. The sampled logging control test passes.

summary: The change adds a privileged manage_payees route (POST /payees/{id}/reopen) without MFA, which violates MFA-1. The exception it cites, EXC-0214, expired on 2026-10-19, before the review time. The change's own CI run fails on the final commit, with the registered exhaustive MFA-1 control test flagging the new route, so CHG-4 is also violated and the lapsed MFA-1 ledger evidence has no valid replacement. Ticket, independent code review, and security review requirements are met, but the violations require rejection.
